batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c S Tyagi b JA Morkel

batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: st KC Sangakkara b RR Powar

batting.name: ML Hayden
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b RR Powar

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c K Goel b J Theron

batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: st KC Sangakkara b PP Chawla

balls.text: low full toss outside off, and he hits it for one to deep cover
yorker outside off, digs it out for one
length ball on the pads, and Irfan lofts it over wide long-on. Poor last over. Top-class batting. No surprise with the score then
yorker, and Morkel has done himself a disfavour by getting a hand on it, and because it is slowed down, Marsh hares back for two. He is not thinking about the hundred
poor bowling, gentle, knee-high full toss, on leg stump, with short fine up, Irfan deals with it nicely
low full toss, hit past extra cover, and they come back for two. Marsh's fans would have hoped for a single - he is 13 short of a hundred
superb shot, can't say the same about the bowling. Provides him length on middle stump, Marsh's front leg is out of the way, and the ball is out of the straight boundary
mis-hit, inside edge towards square leg for one
another mis-hit from Irfan, but this top edge goes straight over the keeper's head, and Irfan is smiling as he sees it go for four in the V behind the wicket
hit down the ground, doesn't make good connection, falls short of long-off
Phew. He has stood back and set up for a six down the ground, come what may! It's a slower ball, he clears the front leg, and lofts it over long-on. As clean a shot as any he has hit today
top edge on an attempted big shot, Tyagi runs in from third man and drops it
another yorker outside off, and he has incredibly steered it fine of third man for four. Top shot
yorker down the leg side, gets only a leg-bye
full and wide, and he has steered it down to third man
length ball, Irfan goes across the line again, but the midwicket has been moved to the boundary
comes down the track, converts it into a full toss, and hits it over midwicket. Can afford to charge to Morkel's pace
nice yorker, can't do much with that
half-volley outside off, finds extra cover on the drive, and Ashwin misses the direct hit at the striker's end: marsh had given up
yorker, hit down the ground, not powerfully, hence they come back for two
slower ball, 117ks Irfan misses out on a swipe across the line
short ball, beats him on the pull
another big shot goes wrong, but again it is placed well, wide enough of long-off, and they come back for two. 50 off 36 for this partnership
goes for the big shot, gets the toe end, third man is square, and they come back for two
fired down the leg side, doesn't get good connection, Dhoni too gets a hand on it, hence it is just a single to short fine
driven, but straight to extra cover in the circle
turns and stays low, but he manages to pull it to square leg
powerful shot, but hit to long-on
Irfan is in now. Dances down the track, drags it across from off and manages to hit it wide of deep midwicket
short and wide, cut away to sweeper-cover
full, outside off, driven with an open face, Badri fields at point. Was that a drop?
full toss, misses out, hits on the bounce to extra cover
full and wide, this time the line is correct, halfway between and off stump and that wide line
full and wide, too wide
this could be even bigger than the one he hit two overs ago. Length ball, 117ks, Marsh slog-sweeps it, over wide long-on, out of the stadium. As the big screen there says, New Balls Please
slogs a length ball across the line, to long-on for one
runs this one from middle and leg to past point for a single
sharp turn there, pushed down to long-on for a single
another superb shot. Comes down the track again and hits him powerfully and straight, right enough of long-on
fuller, middle and leg, pushed down to long-on
fired into the pads, helped away for one
stops in his follow through, Marsh has no such stopping thoughts on his mind, shimmies down and lofts this dead straight down the ground. Fifty up too
into the pads, hit to deep midwicket for one
short, down the leg side, Marsh takes toll, pulling it over short fine
angled into the pads, worked away to square leg for a single
pushes this one down to long-on
biggest six in Dharamsala! At least in televised matches. Flighted outside off, Marsh goes on a knee, and slog-sweeps it into the roof straight down the ground
fuller this time, pushed to long-on for one
short ball, and pulled away to deep midwicket for one
Raina has got the big wicket! Yuvraj looks to sweep a full delivery, misses, the ball pitches middle and leg, turns away and gets him in the back leg
flighted, punched on the up, straight to extra cover
punches this one to sweeper-cover for one
flighted into the pads, worked away for one
full ball, hit down to long-on for one
looks to make room and cut, but this is too full and beats him
presses forward to defend this flighted delivery
bowled him! Stays a touch low. Sanga is looking for the big sweep shot, and it's a straight delivery that squeezes under his swing and takes the off stump
good fielding by Bollinger at long-off, Sanga comes down the track and hits it straight and fast, but Bollinger dives to his left to save two runs
short ball, around off, creates room by moving away and cuts it past point
comes down the track, the ball stops at him, but he manages to push it to long-off for one
flighted around middle and off, pushed back, Ashwin fields to his right
fired into the pads, too far down the leg side, and he gets just enough bat on it to render Bollinger's run from short fine vain
short ball, pulled away to deep square leg
bunted into the leg side, and runs hard to come back back for two before deep midwicket can get into the act
angled into the pads, Sanga rocks back to shorten the length, and then gets it past short fine. Good shot to get to 1000 IPL runs
shimmies down the track and hits this to long-on for one
looks to play with an open face but there is not enough room to work with
steers this one from outside off for one
full ball, driven to deep point for one
slower ball, guided to third man for one
even more powerful, another gentle delivery, and Marsh again stands and waits and flat-bats straight back
another gentle ball outside off, Marsh deals with it severely, clearing the front leg, and slapping it back to the straight boundary
gentle full ball outside off, hit down to long-off for one
looks to run this one down too, but hits it too hard to point
comes down the track to flick this one into the on side
pauses in the follow through, fires in a quicker one, Marsh opens the face to take a single to short third man
angled into the pads, helped away for one
flat into the leg stump, worked away for one
short, outside off, hit back to the bowler
poor delivery, down the leg side, slightly back of a length, and he glances it fine
back of a length, around off, no room, pushed to midwicket
half-volley around off, goes for the slog this time, but doesn't get the timing, and hits it to midwicket
fuller, closer to off, pushed to point
wide length ball, Sanga sends it crashing past extra cover. Just slightly clears the front leg to allow himself space to swing those arms
full and wide, driven to sweeper-cover for one
stops in the follow through, Raina style, Sanga stays back and pushes this shortish ball to point
this one lets the pressure off, short, into the pads, with fine leg up, Sanga doesn't miss out
nicely flighted on middle and off, defended
pushed to long-off for one
looks for the big shot, gets an inside edge towards short fine
shimmies down the track to push this to long-off for one
mean yorker, gets him in the toe, but it is heading down the leg side
extra bounce from just back of a length, beats him outside off
hit to mid-on, Tyagi misfields, letting through couple of runs
short, not too wide, but he manages to upper-cut it, one bounce to third man
too short again, Sanga rocks back, and pulls in front of square, the front leg in air, and the gap found
back of a length, around off, no room, defended with an open face
looks to sweep, but fails to make contact
fired into the pads, defended to midwicket
dropped! Morkel, who has just benefited from that Tyagi catch drops a much simpler straightforward offering. Marsh sweeps straight down his lap at short fine and he lets it spill through
angled in, defended to on
flighted outside off, defended
full ball from round the stumps, played to on side, Bollinger makes a diving save at straightish midwicket

what a catch! Against the run of play, Tyagi has pulled this one out of the hat. Mahela makes room to go over mid-off, the ball is not quite that full, and hence he doesn't get enough elevation. But it takes all of Tyagi's height, and a perfectly timed full-stretch jump for it to stick in the right hand
short and wide, and cut away, in the air but in the gap past point. Mahela is gracefully tucking into this gifts
slightly shorter, not in the driving arc, Mahela defends it to the leg side
too full again, Mahela clears the front leg, and chips it over mid-off. Super timing, it bounced only about six feet inside the straight boundary
similar delivery, this time he fails to make contact but takes a leg-bye
and another poor delivery, outswinger, swinging too far down marsh's pads, and he has flicked it past the short fine leg. Easy four runs
angled across him, left alone
steers this wide one down to third man for one
stays back to pull this one, stays a touch low and hits him in the thigh, shorter than the previous delivery
comeback! kicks from back of a length, into the top glove and then into the chest
shot! another short ball, and Marsh is waiting, and pulls him in front of square. The swivel-pull
Bollinger gives the reluctant umpire an exercise of arms. This one is even further down the leg side
starts with a short one, down the leg side, umpire Saheba doesn't call it a wide. Not a great call
poor delivery, short, straying down the pads, and he gets inside the line of it and pulls it over long leg
shimmies down the track and bang! Clean swing over long-on for six
gets close to this short delivery, and steers it to third man for one
more width, Marsh goes for the big cut but is beaten
better line for the left-hander, pitching off and moving away, left alone
seams in a bit too much again, worked away off the hips for a single to fine leg
seams in after pitching middle and leg, big wide

and Dhoni has carried Chennai through. Length ball again, and Dhoni has hit another huge blistering six over wide long-on. And he is pumped. He has won many big matches in his career, but I have never seen him so pumped. Punches himself in the jaw, like a boxer. The Chennai team, behind Chawla at long-off, rushes through the fielder to congratulate Dhoni
McLeodganj, send the ball back please! misses the yorker length, and boy, has he bludgeoned it. From wide outside off, he sends it miles over wide long-on. Biggest televised six in Himachal Pradesh
yes it is. Back of a length, Dhoni top-edges, skied towards long-off, Chawla is slow in coming in, and lets through two by misfielding on the bounce
lovely shot! Nearly a yorker, Dhoni goes deep into the crease, and drives this wide of long-off for four. What power
finally bowls the yorker, hit to long-off for one
short ball, cramps him, gets a single to midwicket
he just can't bowl the yorker! But fields well. Length ball again, bludgeoned back at him, he sticks out the boot ans saves three
dropped or saved two, take your call. Dhoni throws everything at this, gets a healthy high edge, Sanga goes high, gets gloves to it, the ball bursts through, they get two
length ball, and he murders it over his head. Poor bowling. Don't. Bowl. Length. To. Dhoni
poor bowling, short, sitting up at his pace, and he absolutely wallops it past midwicket
misses the yorker by about a foot, and Morkel clears the front leg and crunches it straight of long-on
dropped by Irfan, Morkel slogs, gets a top edge, Irfan runs in from third man and misjudges a skier, and doesn't get under it, and it spills through his outstretched hands
comes back with a lovely yorker, just a single
low full toss, hit to long-off straight, single. And Bowden signals a no-ball, and then a free-hit. Huge no-ball too
top cricket from both, yorker outside off, he opens the face and finds the gap between backward point and cover point
yorker attempted, low full toss delivered, hit powerfully, but straight to long-on
yorker outside off, dug out for a single
googly, outside off, hit to long-off for a single
full delivery, hit to extra cover, they turn down the single off the misfield
misses a slog sweep, slides out on the sweep, Sanga whips the bails off, and Bowden doesn't even need third umpire for it
Fifty for Badri! sweeps this from leg stump, over midwicket
charges at him, hits straight enough of long-off to come back for two
back of a length, punched to sweeper-cover for one
low full toss, and he helps it over midwicket for a one-bounce four
misses a leg-stump full toss, gets a leg-bye
whipped to wide long-on, hares back for two
back of a length, Dhoni misses an across-the-line whip, and gets two leg-byes past the keeper
low full toss, hit along the ground to long-off
walks down the track, hit to long-on, Yuvraj charges in, one-handed pick-up and throw keeps them down to one
charges down the track, converts this into a low full toss, and bisects long-on and long-off. One bounce for four
yorker smeared into the leg stump. Dot
angled in, turned to midwicket for one
arm ball, Badri is hurried into the pull, gets one
looks to charge at him, Yuvi stays flat and straight, hit back to the bowler
hits this to deep midwicket for one
full and wide, Badri is backing away and has to leave it alone
nearly a yorker, Dhoni hits it powerfully, but the long-on is wide and keeps them down to one
goes for the scoop, Irfan beats him with an offcutter but he has moved so far across he is outside the line of off
walks down the pitch again, goes for the big shot over midwicket, gets an inside edge onto the pad
more swing, beats Dhoni as he walks down the pitch
swing, full, into the pads,  nearly a yorker, and Dhoni whips it square of deep square leg, and the fine leg is in the circle
legbreak, turns across him, gets an outside edge to short third
another lbw shout, and a good one too, topspinner, plumb in front of stumps. Umpire Saheba reckons bat first, but it is pad first. Second reprieve for Badri from Saheba
Badri dances down the track, Chawla bowls full, and wide, and he drives square and wide of sweeper-cover
goes for the big whip over midwicket, gets a thick bottom edge to short third man
comes down the track and mis-hits it on the bounce to long-on
flighted delivery, hit to long-off for one
walks down the wicket, and turns this slower ball to square leg for one
full, on the pads, flicked away, but the fine leg has moved back
shot! Moves across and scoops a length ball fine of short fine leg. Badri has come back from that mini slump
beats his scoop, too far down the leg side, Bowden calmly waits for a fake appeal to prevent wide to end, and then stretches his arms. That's how you do it
and he responds with a lovely six! Gets a length ball, goes inside-out, and swings it clean over long-off. Into his own dugout
backs away, Theron follows him, hit straight to extra cover. Six dots in a row for Badri
slower ball outside off, punched, but Mahela at extra cover dives to keep them to one
goes back in the crease, some premeditation, Chawla bowls full and fast, and he is forced into a defensive shot
flighted outside off, pushed straight to extra cover. Pressure building up
straighter topspinner, Badri is hit in the pad, outside the line of off
looks to steer it, but hits too powerfully to short third
full and straight, Badri plays across the line, umpire reckons inside edge, but there is none. Badri gets away with this
flighted outside off, hit to long-off for one
steers to third man for a single
and he gets off the mark with a nice shot to wide of long-on. He should have got two, but Yuvraj's misfielding allows him four
good timing hurts him! Makes room, goes inside-out to a length ball, sweetly timed and flat, and it carries straight down sweeper-cover's throat. Six feet either side and this might have been a six
back of a length, into the pads, turned to midwicket for one
full and wide, gets a single to point
back of a length, just outside off, drops and runs
shot! flighted outside off, he gets on a knee and lofts him straight over his head, on the full into the boundary cushion
Raina shapes up for the forward movement, Chawla bowls this flat, Raina plays it to point
another half-tracker, and he has deep midwicket in place this time
tossed up nicely, pushed down to long-off for one
fuller, hit straight to straightish extra cover
and starts with a half tracker, which is pulled away over midwicket
full toss, and nicely driven with an open face, wide of sweeper-cover
driven sweetly, to sweeper-cover
top edge for six! moves across the stumps and is hurried up by a back-of-a-length ball, and the edge clears fine leg
sees him back away, bowls full and wide of off, Badri has to stretch to get bat on it
full outside off, nearly a yorker, digs it out for one
full and down the leg side
low full toss, hit straight to straight extra cover
slow through the air, 76ks, plays in front of his body but gets a single to long-off
into the block hole, digs it out for one
Badriiii! Charges at him, gets close to it, and lofts it over wide long-on
short, turning away sharply, cut to sweeper-cover for one
nicely tossed up, plays with an open face for a single to short third man
back of a length, pushed down to long-on
charges down the track and misses a bouncer outside off
full and wide, driven on the up, through the covers
full, angling down the leg side (he is bowling from round the stumps), misses, but gets a leg-bye
back of a length, outside off, pushed to point
tucks him up, played to point
short down the leg side
and he gets stuck into him right away, jumps out of the crease, doesn't matter it is a short delivery, he still slaps it over long-off
guides this one to backward point for one
he has a wide long-on in place, and he gets Raina to step out and loft it in that direction, but he gets it straight enough of Jayawardene
cut away to cover
sharp turn from outside leg, Raina guides it past the slip, and VRV Singh chases it poorly from short third
pushed to mid-on for a sharp single
flighted outside off, turned to square leg

more quality spin! Flight, dip, sucking him out of the crease to get close to the pitch of the ball, and then sharp turn down the leg side, and a sharp stumping. Powar is animated, and he has bowled beautifully. Sanga in place of Bisla has been a big improvement when it comes to keeping
shot! charges down the track, goes with the swing, and inside-out over extra cover, good cocking of the wrists at the last moment to provide the power
heaves and misses! Is beaten by this full ball that goes straight with the angle, and is hit in the thigh
too short for his pace, and he pulls him over midwicket even though he is on front foot
swing, outside off, driven on the up, straight to cover
back of a length, moves back in and cramps him and gets a single to point
shot, effective shot, length ball, goes over midwicket, even though it is not timed well, he clears the infield
and more beautiful spin bowling, flatter delivery, 87ks, but just as much rip on it, pitches middle and off and beats him outside off

Air Time! Lovely spin bowling. Generously tossed up, Hayden sets himself up to launch this one, but it bounces slightly shorter than he expects and then turns just enough to take the outside edge. Good catch too by Sanga
not much flight here, pushed to mid-on for one
flatter, Vijay comes down the track and hits it back to the bowler
Powar slows it down even further, and Vijay stays in the crease to defend this one
this time Vijay's footwork is better, comes a long way down the track to get close to the pitch of the ball, and smacks it past mid-on
punched square, Marsh dives at point and saves three runs
back of a length, outside off, punched wide of mid-off
floated outside off, swinging away, Hayden throws his arms at it, and the toe edge clears the short third man
shorter, outside off, Hayden swats it across the line, can't get it past mid-on
swing there, starts outside off and moves away, Hayden shoulders arms
short ball, wide, runs it down to third man
flatter delivery, beats him, the lbw shout is stifled because it is pitched outside leg
straight, around pads, cramping him
pitched leg, turning away, pushed to mid-off
stays in the crease and turns this to midwicket for one
that's Air Powar for you, lovely flight, some dip, beats him as he charges down, and still finds himself not close to it, the pad saves him
not much turn, defended off the back foot, not the Powar flight yet
